name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Buyers Edge Platform needs someone who runs paid media, SEO, and landing pages day to day while turning vendor-delivered work into finished campaigns, and that is exactly the shape of my marketing work right now. At Solenzo, I run technical SEO audits, build landing pages directly in HTML and CSS, and manage GA4 tracking end to end for B2B clients.

At Level Agency, I designed and ran LinkedIn ad campaigns using an account-based-marketing approach, small, highly researched audiences with A/B-tested setups instead of broad targeting, and I advised clients directly on ad-spend budget planning. I also use ChatGPT and Claude daily as production tools for research, drafting, and campaign analysis, the same AI-assisted workflow this role expects, not a talking point I picked up for the interview.

Before any of that, I spent 15 years as a cook across multiple restaurants. I know what a slow Tuesday dinner service feels like and what a distributor delay does to a kitchen. I am not learning your audience from a brief, I already think the way they think, and that combination is rare in a paid-media candidate.
I'd welcome a conversation about how that fits the Digital Marketing Specialist role. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
